title: Pennsylvania Small Claims Court (2026): Limit, Fees & Filing
rank_math_description: Pennsylvania small claims in 2026: $12,000 limit before a magisterial district judge, $68.50-$171 costs, 30-day appeal and strict wage garnishment limits.
pdf_outline: Checklist: demand letter -> find magisterial district -> civil complaint -> 2026 costs ($68.50/$91/$114/$171) + service -> hearing 12-60 days -> service 10 days before -> hearing -> 30-day appeal (plaintiff: complaint in 20 days) -> order of execution / transfer to Common Pleas
featured_image_prompt: Small-town Pennsylvania magisterial district court office exterior with brick facade, a folder of receipts on a bench in the foreground, navy and crimson accents, editorial photo style, no text

inline_images.prompt: horizontal timeline: complaint, hearing 12-60 days, service 10 days before, hearing, 30-day appeal, navy/crimson on cream

editor_notes: 2026 costs come from 42 Pa.C.S. 1725.1 as published in 204 Pa. Code 29.402; they change every January, so update in the January 2027 refresh.
